text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: pg-primary-high-connections triggered (severity: P1). Pager: @alice-oncall. Link: https://pd.example/incidents/PD12345

alice-oncall: Acking and jumping in. Seeing 502/503 across app tier, check pg connections first.

rohit-db: getting `psql` on primary, tails look like `FATAL:  remaining connection slots are reserved for non-replication superuser connections`. max_connections is 500.

katie-sre: +1. App pod logs show `could not obtain connection from pool: pool timeout` and spike in DB latency (p99 > 2.4s).

alice-oncall: Incident timeline: spike started ~2m ago, traffic up ~30% due to a batch job. Initial mitigation idea: scale PG read replicas and throttle batch job.

pagerduty: Auto-escalation triggered to second on-call in 3m.

rohit-db: Quick checks:
```
SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state <> 'idle';
-- result: 487
SHOW max_connections; -- 500
```
Looks like we're just under max but reserved slots being used. Some long-running queries from worker-service.

katie-sre: Can we temporarily increase max_connections on primary? That needs restart for some configs, not ideal. Alternative: reduce active app connections by marking worker-service readonly or rate-limit.

alice-oncall: I'll put worker-service in maintenance mode. @cs-ops can you notify affected customers?

cs-ops: On it. Notifying customers with impact: ~8% of API requests failing with 5xx (errors on writes). Will send canned message.

rohit-db: While that happens, I'm going to rotate a few app node pools to pick up DB connection parameter changes (short-term) and kill the worst offending queries:
```
SELECT pid, now() - query_start AS runtime, query
FROM pg_stat_activity
WHERE state='active'
ORDER BY runtime DESC
LIMIT 10;
-- then
SELECT pg_cancel_backend(<pid>);
```

alice-oncall: Doing a rolling restart of worker deployment to drop pooled connections: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/worker-service -n production`

incident-bot: PagerDuty: PD12345 acknowledged by alice-oncall at 1798654335.

rohit-db: Cancelled 12 long-running queries (mostly old analytics joins). Connections freed, connected_clients back down. Observed p99 latency drop to ~600ms.

katie-sre: App error rate falling but still some saturation. Redis also showing high client count from cache miss storms: `INFO clients\nconnected_clients: 1023\nmaxclients: 1000` — hitting maxclients on a few nodes. Might be concurrent fallback to DB while cache warms.

alice-oncall: Oof. Redis maxclients hit causes new client rejections. I'm scaling redis instances and temporarily enabling circuit-breaker on read path to limit concurrent cache fills.

rohit-db: After restarts, DB connections stable at ~320 active. No further reserved slot errors.

katie-sre: Scaling notes: `kubectl scale statefulset/redis-cluster --replicas=6 -n infra` and bumped deployment CPU for cache fillers.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: PD12345 escalated to on-call rotation for morning (jamie-morning) at 1798654400.

alice-oncall: Handing off to @jamie-morning. Current status: DB stable, redis scaled, worker-service in maintenance mode, app error rate down from 8% -> 1.2% 5xx. Active mitigation: worker maintenance until batch backoff, monitor 30m, postmortem assigned.

jamie-morning: Taking handoff. Please drop any runbook links here and I'll own the follow-up and postmortem.

rohit-db: Runbook snippets: 1) identify long queries `pg_stat_activity`. 2) cancel or terminate runaway backfills. 3) consider connection pooler (pgbouncer) aggressive pool sizing. 4) ensure workers use pooled connections and respect max inflight.

cs-ops: Customer update posted to status.redwood.example: "Partial outage for write-heavy requests; mitigations in place; working on permanent fix." Will follow up after postmortem.

alice-oncall: Creating incident ticket PD12345 -> GH issue #6789. Adding timeline and commands used. Leaving note: recommend permanent fix: pgbouncer + better batch throttling + redis cache warming strategy.

jamie-morning: Acknowledged. I'll schedule a quick sync with infra/db tomorrow 9am PT. For now, leaving on-call watch for 45m.

incident-bot: Incident PD12345 marked as "stabilized" at 1798654475 by jamie-morning.

alice-oncall: Thanks team. :thumbsup: Will add logs and metrics to the ticket for the postmortem.
